overview.name: Name
overview.slowmodeHint: Wait time between messages per member.
overview.nsfwHint: Members must confirm their age before viewing.

paper.title: Paper
paper.hint: Shared document with live co-editing and margin comments.
paper.shareVisibilityHint: Who can open this paper when using a share link.

voice.e2eeHint: LiveKit E2EE for voice and camera. No recording, transcription, or audio bots.
voice.bitrateHint: Off lets you pick {min}–{max} kbps below.

format.softHint: Users can delete or edit the default text.
format.hardHint: Prefix stays at the start of the input and must appear on sent messages.
format.intro: This text is inserted into the message input for everyone in the channel. Use {soft} if it should be a default they can remove, or {hard} to keep it as a fixed prefix (also enforced when sending text).

forum.managePostHint: Lets the author change listing pin, lock, archive, and tags without Manage Channel on the post.
forum.deleteOwnHint: Lets the author delete the entire post channel (thread).
forum.deleteOthers: Delete others’ messages in their post
forum.deleteOthersHint: Like scoped message moderation inside their thread only.
forum.intro: Members who start a post get these extras on {own} thread only. Server roles and channel permissions still apply for everything else.

danger.intro: These actions are sensitive and may be irreversible. Proceed carefully.
danger.autoDeleteHint: Remove messages older than the retention period. When synced, the category setting applies. Deleted messages remain in the database for 14 days before purge.
danger.deleteDesc: Permanently delete {name}. All messages in this channel will be removed. This cannot be undone.

perm.paperNote: Permissions apply when share visibility is set to {mode}. Change the share visibility in the Overview tab to enable permission controls.
perm.syncHint: When enabled, this channel inherits category-level overwrites from {category}. Turn it off to apply channel-specific rules for roles or individual members.
perm.inheriting: This channel is currently inheriting permissions from {category}. Disable sync to add channel-specific overwrites.
perm.defaultsHint: When enabled, this channel uses defaults from {category} (edit in category settings). Turn off to set overrides only for this channel.
perm.showingDefaults: Showing defaults for {category} — use the gear on that category in the sidebar to edit. Uncheck sync above to override only this channel.

confirm.title: Delete channel “{label}”?
confirm.message:
This cannot be undone.

All messages in this channel will be removed from the mock.
